observedProtectedRead.interpretation: No canonical Case14 owner established by these protected reads. This is not proof that the operation, locator or candidate is absent from the database.

minimumNextNativeRead.entrypoint: Packaged compiled readCase14FixtureEvidenceInTx(tx, ctx, authorization), omitting candidateId, under existing runWithMemoryGovernanceTenant and PrismaService.withTenantUser.
minimumNextNativeRead.composition: Reuse minimal PrismaService + MemoryAuthorizationService imports from apps/api/scripts/meri-case14-recall-setup.mjs. No full AppModule, pending execute, recall bind or budget installer.
minimumNextNativeRead.why: readCase14MemoryOwnerInTx obtains the persisted source-validated locator itself, resolves the original frozen recipe and validates current candidate and pending or approved canonical state.
minimumNextNativeRead.additionalRead: In the same exact-T1 scoped transaction, read only tenant slug and settings_jsonb #> {meriFoundationFixture,pendingMemorySetups,14}; retain operation presence/status and validated locator/hash fields, not the full settings object. First independently require current exact Priya membership/Clerk ID/namespace/role.
minimumNextNativeRead.transaction: Canonical pending/approved guards include FOR SHARE/FOR UPDATE and cannot run in PostgreSQL READ ONLY mode. Use an ordinary scoped transaction with a mandatory outer rollback sentinel after collecting the sanitized result; do not weaken those locks or substitute queries for the owner.
minimumNextNativeRead.output: Existing owner IDs/state/versions/hashes with proposal text omitted; verified locator if present, explicit null/invalid/blocked status otherwise. Preserve error stage/class/allowlisted code without SQL, credentials, full settings or arbitrary exception text.
minimumNextNativeRead.packaging: Exact current API4f immutable image, existing private DB entrypoint, only required DB secrets and approved governance/namespace flags; no workload IAM role or provider secrets; one task, no retry, independent STOPPED/INACTIVE cleanup.

inputShape.recipe: Exact stored Case14 locator or separately prepared prospective Case14 recipe; no caller receipt is authority.

existingPendingCli.plan: inspectPendingMemorySetup verifies current ordinary Pat identity/client wall, requires no existing case operation and absent deterministic candidate, and returns planSha256/tenantRowVersion/priorSettingsSha256. It performs no creation.
existingPendingCli.read: readPendingMemorySetup requires exact SETUP_COMPLETE recipe and fixtureInstanceId and reconstructs pending rows only. It is not the approved-memory owner and must not be used to relabel approved rows as pending.
existingPendingCli.existingOperation: PENDING_MEMORY_EXISTING_OPERATION_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION must stop new setup planning. Recover its actual locator/state, preserve claim and do not choose another instance to evade it.

recipeProvenance.frozenDefinition: evals/meri/live-v1/fixture.mjs MEM-PROPOSAL-14: one memory_candidate_fixture, T1/Aster, pending, text Synthetic Aster candidate for approval.
recipeProvenance.selection: selectPendingMemoryFixturePlan(manifest, 14) selects exactly MEM-PROPOSAL-14 with Pat proposer and Priya reviewer.
recipeProvenance.limit: Searched named C1/C2/fresh outputs, versioned release archives and the present cap-meri-foundation-evidence directory; no historical Case14 operation recipe or setup receipt was located. Case17 instance63c7bb50-1971-49df-96b9-c6c94c562078 is not adopted as Case14 authority.
recipeProvenance.futureProspectivePlan: If the exact current DB owner read proves no prior case14 operation, root may separately prepare a fresh UUIDv4 prospective Case14 recipe using these grounded identities and the frozen source. A new local recipe is not evidence of an existing fixture, and its read-only plan is not authorization to execute.

nextBranch.pending: Use the exact stored recipe and canonical owner to prepare the existing one-decision Meri approval path separately.
nextBranch.approved: Do not replay approval. Preserve actual decision/audit/item/version and prepare only the existing recall prerequisites separately.
nextBranch.absent: Record exact scoped database absence; prospective plan can then be prepared without creating a fixture.
nextBranch.claimedOrInvalid: Retain and reconcile the existing operation; no reset or alternate-instance retry.

limits: Source/prerequisite preparation only. No module owner invocation, test rerun, cloud/auth/database/browser/provider or journal action.
No current fixture presence/absence/ready state, pending decision, immutable release attestation or original row14 acceptance is claimed.
